Overview

Owensboro is a city in KY with a population of 60,000. Ohio River city known for its barbecue, bluegrass music, and riverfront park. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
